description:
Generate the initial wiki content by ingesting existing project documentation as raw sources, following Karpathy's LLM Wiki ingest pattern (https://gist.githubusercontent.com/karpathy/442a6bf555914893e9891c11519de94f/raw/ac46de1ad27f92b28ac95459c782c07f6b8c964a/llm-wiki.md). This bootstraps the wiki so it's useful from day one rather than starting empty.

**Sources to ingest:**
- VISION.md → identity/vision.md
- README.md → identity/pitch.md (extract relevant content)
- docs/roadmap.md → strategy/roadmap.md
- docs/decisions.md → strategy/decisions.md
- docs/risks.md → quality/platform-health.md (risk section)
- docs/concepts/ARCHITECTURE.md → operations/architecture.md
- docs/PATTERNS.md → operations/patterns.md
- docs/LESSONS_LEARNED.md → operations/lessons-learned.md
- docs/business-solutions.md → revenue/model.md
- docs/deployment/ → capabilities/deployment.md
- Each scenario's README.md/PRD.md → capabilities/scenarios/{name}.md (business context extract)
- Director-swarm's current decisions and priorities → strategy/priorities.md
- The 22 existing initiatives → strategy/initiatives/{name}.md (one page each)

This is NOT a mechanical copy — each source should be synthesized into wiki-appropriate content. The scenario README talks about code; the wiki scenario page should talk about what the scenario means for the project (revenue potential, who uses it, what it enables, deployment status).

Also generate the initial index.md cataloging all created pages, and seed log.md with the initial ingest operation.

After seeding, run project-wiki publish to push all content to Knowledge Observatory for embedding.
name: project-wiki-initial-content-seed
title: Seed Wiki With Initial Content From Existing Documentation
